race.comment: FIFTYFIVECHEVY (2) was just fair second up at Illawarra Grange when in the market but had been good fresh at Moruya and looks set to peak third up getting out to 1600m here. Can settle handy and prove very hard to run down. INVASIVE DREAMS (5) struggled at Newcastle last time but turns around quickly here having won well prior. Can do better from the gun draw. SERPICO (3) was fair fresh at Hawkesbury but can do better up in trip while JOHNNY SMASH (9) might be better suited back slightly in trip and is in the mix. RUSH ATTACK (4) looks close to a win following a sound second over 1600m at Newcastle, beaten a nose.
